messages:
Maria (AE): EdgeML wants a POC this week focused on tail latency and burst costs. They care about p95/p99 during spikes and monthly spend. Can SRE/SE own load plan + cost est?
Devon (SRE): I can. Quick: model size/precision, seq len, avg tokens, and can we use prefix/KV cache?
Maria (AE): 7B fp16 from our catalog. seq len ~256, avg output 120 tokens. Target steady 500 qps, 30s bursts to 2k qps. Budget: incremental < $6k/mo if possible.
Ryan (Sales Eng): Draft plan—Devon please sanity-check:
- Warmup 5m 50->500 qps
- Steady 30m @500 qps (p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec)
- 3x 30s bursts to 2000 qps, 2m apart
- Cold-cache single-node run
- Repeat with prefix cache on
- Collect GPU util, mem, network, traces, token counts
Devon (SRE): Good. Using vegeta wrapper. Example command:
vegeta attack -rate=500 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > steady500.json
Devon (SRE): API example:
POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>, X-Model: redwood-7b-fp16
Body: {"input":"<prompt>", "max_tokens":120, "stream":false}
Devon (SRE): Observability: p50/p95/p99, throughput, queue depth, token cost. Alert if p99 > 800ms.
Maria (AE): Can we convert tokens/sec to $/mo for their profile?
Ryan (Sales Eng): Rough: steady 500 qps * 120 tokens * 30 days => estimate ~ $3.5k/mo baseline; spikes add variance. Will refine after run.
Priya (Security): Enterprise blockers: KMS-managed keys, audit logs, SOC2. They asked about VPC for production; POC fine on hosted if retention + logs ok.
Maria (AE): Need Priya's answers for the security questionnaire — gating for Dedicated.
Priya (Security): Will draft tonight. Hosted POC can use short-lived keys and retention statement. VPC -> Dedicated pricing impact.
Devon (SRE): Smoke run results (night): steady 500 p95=180ms, p99=420ms. Burst tail ~780ms. Cold-cache p95 ~1.1s on one node. infra-bot uploaded artifacts to gs://redwood-poc/edge-1718123456
infra-bot: upload completed: gs://redwood-poc/edge-1718123456/steady500.json
Devon (SRE): Observed KV cold-miss on first burst; enabling prefix cache cut cold p95 to ~420ms.
Ryan (Sales Eng): Nice. Can you draft a short customer-friendly writeup: steady metrics, tail during bursts, effect of prefix cache, and monthly cost with/without Dedicated?
Devon (SRE): Will do a 1-page summary with vegeta commands, raw numbers, recommendation: for tight tail under bursts recommend Reserved Dedicated or autoscale with warm warmup buffer + prefix caching.
Maria (AE): Also they asked about no data egress to other tenants for POC. Priya?
Priya (Security): For hosted POC we guarantee logical isolation and no cross-tenant access. Physical isolation requires Dedicated. I'll add clear language.
Maria (AE): Next steps: Devon to post run summary + refined cost calc by EOD tomorrow. Priya to send security Q&A. Ryan to prep short deck comparing Hosted vs Dedicated for tail SLAs and costs. Scheduling: customer engineers want full run Thu 09:00 PST. Devon owns. :thumbsup:
Devon (SRE): Owning it — summary by EOD tomorrow, full run Thu 09:00 PST.
Maria (AE): Thanks team — this is deal-critical.
